description: Source code for a PHP class implementing a Pratt parser for JMESPath expressions, including token handling, parsing logic, and syntax error management.

classes.name: Parser
classes.description: A PHP class implementing a Pratt parser for JMESPath expressions, capable of parsing and generating an AST from expression strings.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a JMESPath expression into an abstract syntax tree (AST).

methods.name: expr
methods.description: Parses an expression with a given right binding power.

methods.name: nud_identifier
methods.description: Handles parsing of identifier tokens.

methods.name: nud_quoted_identifier
methods.description: Handles parsing of quoted identifier tokens.

methods.name: nud_current
methods.description: Handles parsing of the current node token.

methods.name: nud_literal
methods.description: Handles parsing of literal tokens.

methods.name: nud_expref
methods.description: Handles parsing of expression reference tokens.

methods.name: nud_not
methods.description: Handles parsing of logical NOT tokens.

methods.name: nud_lparen
methods.description: Handles parsing of parenthesized expressions.

methods.name: nud_lbrace
methods.description: Handles parsing of hash/dictionary literals.

methods.name: nud_flatten
methods.description: Handles parsing of flatten projection.

methods.name: nud_filter
methods.description: Handles parsing of filter expressions.

methods.name: nud_star
methods.description: Handles parsing of wildcard tokens.

methods.name: nud_lbracket
methods.description: Handles parsing of array or object index expressions.

methods.name: led_lbracket
methods.description: Handles parsing of array index or slice after '['.

methods.name: led_flatten
methods.description: Handles parsing of flatten projection after '.'

methods.name: led_dot
methods.description: Handles parsing of dot notation for property access.

methods.name: led_or
methods.description: Handles parsing of logical OR expressions.

methods.name: led_and
methods.description: Handles parsing of logical AND expressions.

methods.name: led_pipe
methods.description: Handles parsing of pipe operator for function chaining.

methods.name: led_lparen
methods.description: Handles parsing of function call arguments.

methods.name: led_filter
methods.description: Handles parsing of filter conditions.

methods.name: led_comparator
methods.description: Handles parsing of comparison operators.

methods.name: parseProjection
methods.description: Parses projection expressions following dot or bracket notation.

methods.name: parseDot
methods.description: Parses dot notation expressions.

methods.name: parseKeyValuePair
methods.description: Parses key-value pairs in hash literals.

methods.name: parseWildcardObject
methods.description: Parses wildcard object projections.

methods.name: parseWildcardArray
methods.description: Parses wildcard array projections.

methods.name: parseArrayIndexExpression
methods.description: Parses array index or slice expressions.

methods.name: parseMultiSelectList
methods.description: Parses multi-select list expressions.

methods.name: syntax
methods.description: Creates a SyntaxErrorException with a message.

methods.name: lookahead
methods.description: Returns the type of the next token without consuming it.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances to the next token, optionally matching expected token types.

methods.name: assertNotToken
methods.description: Ensures the current token is not of a specific type.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Handles calls to undefined token handler methods, providing error messages.
